title: Spec: addition of content stats representation to v4
summary: Eduard Tudenhöfner called a vote on adding the content stats representation to the v4 spec through PR 14234. He framed the vote as acknowledging the direction taken for representing stats in v4, and stated that changes to the stats representation can still happen until the entire v4 spec is formally finalized. The vote was open for 72 hours. All votes cast were +1; wypoon qualified his vote as being for the direction. Eduard Tudenhöfner added his own binding +1, announced that the vote passed, and said he would merge the PR so that work can iterate on the implementation changes.

positions.stance: Add the content stats representation to the v4 spec as an agreed direction, with changes still possible until v4 is finalized.

outcome.note: Passed with 5 binding and 2 non-binding +1 votes, and no +0 or -1 votes. PR 14234 is to be merged.

why_it_matters: The content stats structure is now in the v4 spec draft, so implementation work can build on it, though it may still change before v4 is finalized.
